summary: Wicks voted aye on AB 715, creating an antisemitism coordinator and classroom-material oversight in California schools, and coauthored the failed AB 1468, which would have limited high-school ethnic studies to domestic experiences. She called the October 7 violence "terrorism, plain and simple" and stated she "stands with the Israeli people." Endorsement by the Alameda County Jewish Democratic Club and support from California Jewish Democrats reinforce this Israel-centric positioning.
